title: WALTEUR Data Inventory
description: Inventory of every field the system stores or processes, classified for privacy and compliance. One entry per field: its data class, lawful basis, purposes, retention, residency, and the sinks it flows to.

name.description: Field name as it appears in the system.

data_class.description: Privacy classification of the field's content.

lawful_basis.description: Legal basis for processing this field (e.g. GDPR Art.6: consent, contract, legal_obligation, vital_interests, public_task, legitimate_interests; or 'n/a' for anonymous).

purpose.description: Specific, enumerated purposes for which this field is processed (purpose limitation).

retention_ttl_days.description: Number of days the field is retained before deletion. Null means indefinite/no-TTL (must be justified by lawful_basis).

residency_region.description: Geographic region where the field is stored/processed (e.g. eu-west-1, EU, US, global).

sinks.description: Downstream destinations the field flows to (datastores, logs, third-party processors, analytics).
